```{r}
library(cowsay)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)

species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")
species_df <- tibble()

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, "s")
  current_row <- tibble(
    Species = spp,
    Starts_with_S = has_s
  )
  species_df <- species_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(species_df)
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
break_df <- tibble()
number<- seq_len(5)
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  dailyitem<-sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  dailynumber <- sample(number, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = dailyitem,number=dailynumber)
  break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)
}
  





gt(break_df)


```
